verdict.rationale: The docs confirm employees have a 'My Equity' view and a guided exercise workflow (selecting shares, signing exercise documents, spousal consent), showing some employee-facing equity interaction, but there is no evidence of plain-language explanations of tax treatment, exercise windows, or dilution impact for employees — the rest of the evidence is entirely admin/company-facing (cap table, ASC 718, board consents). Missing for 10: employee-facing tax treatment explanations, exercise window/deadline guidance, dilution impact explanations in plain language, and any independent corroboration of an educational employee UX.
